entities.summary: Berdibek Mashbekuly Saparbayev was a Kazakh politician who was the Minister of Labor and Social Protection of Population in the Government of Kazakhstan from 2005 to 2007 and in 2019, governor of Aktobe Region, Deputy Prime Minister from 2019 to 2020. From 10 February 2020 to 7 April 2022, he was the akim of Zhambyl region.
